demo.notes: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA — not an official record.
demo.steps:
A demo case with synthetic data was created. To complete the workflow:
1. Case details & units: verify units (metres) and set the coordinate type.
2. Setback rule tables → Versions: verify the synthetic rule version.
3. Property boundary & edges: verify the boundary.
4. Previous licenses: add and verify a record.
5. Calculate, then open the PDF report.

help.limitations:
Known limitations of this version:
• DWG requires ODA File Converter and is not yet verified with real DWG files.
• Trim/Extend work on LINE entities only.
• HATCH, 3D solids, images and paper-space entities are not imported (always listed in the import report).
• Survey/regulatory plan transformation is not implemented: only an extent check and unchanged reference insertion.
• Engine diagnostic messages are in English.
• Office documents cannot be embedded in the PDF; convert to PDF first.
• Local accounts are not a security boundary.
